svg.title: After the editor
svg.desc: Manuel's black Audi S5 B8.5, traced from his own photograph, and his photography and design work. After the editor. My S5 B8.5. Black, low, polished 20s. Chasing light. Cars, wildlife and places worth getting up early for. Sony α7 IV in hand; Lightroom, Photoshop and DaVinci Resolve afterwards. My portfolio brings both sides together: photography, design and a GPU fluid simulation you can play with.

g.aria-label: My S5 B8.5. Black, low, polished 20s.

svg.title: My Audi S5 B8.5
svg.desc: Vector contours traced from my own photograph: lowered black coupe, polished split-spoke wheels and the original three-quarter perspective. A light trace follows the bonnet and shoulder line.
